question.problem: If $y$ varies inversely with $x$ and $y=2$ when $x=4,$ find the value of $y$ when $x=\frac{4}{5}.$
question.worked_solution:
Since $y$ varies inversely with $x,$ we use the equation

$$
y=\frac{k}{x}.
$$

We are told that $y=2$ when $x=4.$ We substitute this data into the equation to find $k:$

$$
\begin{aligned}2 & =\frac{k}{4} \\ 2\cdot 4 & =k \\ 8 & =k\end{aligned}
$$

So, the inverse variation is given by 

$$
y=\frac{8}{x}.
$$

Finally, substituting the value of $x=\frac{4}{5}$ into this equation gives

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\frac{8}{(\frac{4}{5})} \\  & =8÷\frac{4}{5} \\  & =8\cdot \frac{5}{4} \\  & =\frac{40}{4} \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
